invariants.rationale: Option.of and Option.empty both return non-null Option objects.
The method cannot be called with a null HoodieWriteConfig argument.
If config.populateMetaFields() is true, result should be Option.empty(), otherwise it should be Option.of(...), hence present.
If result contains a value, it means populateMetaFields was false.
If result is empty, it was due to populateMetaFields returning true.
